Ultimately from Proto-Slavic *smьrdъ, Proto-Slavic *smьrdě̀ti (“to stink”) Cognates include Ukrainian смерд (smerd), Belarusian смерд (smjerd) or Belarusian смердзь (smjerdzʹ), Polish smerd.
